paragraphs.text: Crown Technical Systems proposes to supply a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad lineup for the Syracuse Airport project. This lineup includes eighteen 15 kV vacuum circuit breaker positions equipped with protective relays and controls, two revenue meter positions, two sets of 15 kV isolation switches, bus voltage transformers (VTs), and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs).
